emily (AE): quick ask : Fwding a request from AuroraEdge. They want a 5-month temporary incremental rate cut + small onboarding credit while their integration stabilizes. Can finance approve a one-off exception?
dan (Sales Ops): details: committed monthly tokens = 220M, expected drop to ~130M for ~5 months. customer requests concession only on incremental usage above floor. proposed: $8,200 onboarding credit + incremental rate 0.0032 -> 0.0024 for 5 months. legal ok with amendment.
emily (AE): routing to @marta for impact and GL. I'll attach SFDC opp once I have the signed amendment.
marta (Finance): need quick delta calc, GL account, and whether to amortize credit. Also confirm 'incremental-only' clause and auto-revert.
emily (AE): short calc: delta = 0.0008 * expected 130M = $104,000/month -> $520,000 over 5 months. plus $8,200 credit = ~$528,200 gross impact. Note: if incremental is zero, no change.
marta (Finance): thanks. GL: promo-credits-2026-WE. amortize $8,200 over 2 months. Conditional approval: yes to credit + temporary incremental rate provided 1) signed amendment with explicit incremental-only wording, 2) SFDC order updated, 3) OPS ticket created for rate override. Finance will post final sign-off in the ticket.
zack (RevOps): created OPS-8234 for the override; will wait for amendment PDF and GL confirmation before applying.
emily (AE): attached draft amendment to SFDC (internal link) and asked legal to sign today.
credit-bot: Auto-reminder: billing will schedule rate window once OPS-8234 marked ready. suggested effective window: 2026-08-01 -> 2026-12-31.
marta (Finance): once OPS-8234 shows amendment and GL set, finance will update billing. Conditional approval recorded here for audit.
dan (Sales Ops): saving thread for audit. :lock:
